connector.evidence: The card shroud and portions of its PCB are visible, but the actual lower PCIe contact edge is not exposed clearly enough to sample.
connector.uncertainty: Contact-edge position, axis, and notch cannot be established from these views. No hidden contact points are inferred.

samples.surface: Visible solid side rail of the motherboard PCIe socket housing below the CPU area.
Separated solid side-rail surface of the same PCIe socket housing.

socket.evidence: The right camera shows an elongated motherboard expansion socket below the CPU, distinct from the illuminated RAM sockets. Its exposed housing supports rough axis localization.
socket.uncertainty: Samples estimate the housing axis only; they are neither mating endpoints nor the slot-gap centerline. The internal key is not resolved. Clearance and insertion alignment remain unknown.

next_view: An unobstructed close oblique view of the card's lower PCB contact edge is needed to expose the contact surface and, if possible, its notch. A closer view into the motherboard socket would be needed to resolve its internal key.
